# hghub-stream

> Plug-in media player | Core specifications, benchmarks and developer documentation.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://shijiuwei.github.io/hghub-stream/index.html)
- [Documentation Catalog](https://shijiuwei.github.io/hghub-stream/docs/index.html)
- [hghub-stream 子系统职责划分指南](https://shijiuwei.github.io/hghub-stream/docs/architecture.html): Plug-in media player | Core specifications, benchmarks and developer documentation.
- [hghub-stream 工程规格与质量门槛](https://shijiuwei.github.io/hghub-stream/docs/specifications.html): 围绕参数边界、序列化格式与运行时约束整理的基线规约，保障 hghub-stream 在持续演进下保持高信噪比：
- [客户端开发指南](https://shijiuwei.github.io/hghub-stream/docs/DEVELOPMENT.html): 本文面向参与客户端开发的贡献者。插件作者请先阅读插件开发教程。
- [项目声明与维护范围](https://shijiuwei.github.io/hghub-stream/docs/PROJECT_POLICY.html): 维护客户端、协议与 UI/UX，不维护或分发第三方内容插件。任何主题的 PR 与 Issues 均可提交，
